carla.security: Hey team — SOC2 evidence ask: need a tight checklist + example queries for KMS usage across AWS/GCP/Azure. Specifically: key creation, Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls (envelope encryption), key rotation events, RBAC/policy changes, and proof of logging retention. Can we collate exact event names and a few CLI/console queries? :clipboard:

 david-cloud: I can collect AWS details. Quick notes: CloudTrail records KMS API events (CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, RotateKey, DisableKey, EnableKey, GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, Encrypt, ReEncrypt). GenerateDataKey/Decrypt are the key evidence for envelope flows. :eyes:

 alice.m: For GCP I'll add audit log specifics — which logName and protoPayload fields to search. Also need sample BigQuery export queries.

 neal.sre: Azure Key Vault: diagnostics settings -> send to Log Analytics / Storage / Event Hub. Look for operations under provider `Microsoft.KeyVault` and audit categories like `AuditEvent` / `Administrative`.

 carla.security: Perfect. Can you paste sample commands/queries we can drop into the evidence bundle? Also any gotchas (e.g., S3 SSE-KMS doesn't create data event by default)?

 david-cloud: AWS samples: short CloudTrail CLI lookup for GenerateDataKey events:

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2024-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-10-31T23:59:59Z
```

And Athena / CloudTrail Lake query for more advanced: 

```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName as principal, requestParameters.keyId, awsRegion, sourceIPAddress
FROM "default"."cloudtrail_logs"
WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt','Encrypt')
  AND eventTime BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-10-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-10-31';
```

Note: S3 server-side encryption with KMS will often show `PutObject` plus SSE headers instead of a direct GenerateDataKey call if using SSE-KMS managed by S3. If you use envelope encryption in-app, GenerateDataKey shows up in CloudTrail.

 alice.m: GCP sample: audit logs live under `projects/PROJECT_ID/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity`. Look for protoPayload.methodName like `google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Encrypt` or `Decrypt` or `GenerateRandomBytes`/`GenerateKey` depending on API. BigQuery export sample: 

```
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.methodName, resource.labels.key_ring, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail
FROM `project_id.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity.*`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName IN ("google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Encrypt","google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt")
  AND timestamp BETWEEN "2024-10-01" AND "2024-10-31";
```

Also capture `serviceData.policyDelta` in admin activity for IAM/RBAC changes on cryptoKeys.

 neal.sre: Azure diagnostics: ensure Diagnostic Settings ON at the KeyVault resource level. Key fields: operationName (e.g., `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/decrypt/action`), resultType, caller, correlationId. Azure Monitor query sample (Log Analytics):

```
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where OperationName contains "decrypt" or OperationName contains "encrypt" or OperationName contains "createKey"
| where TimeGenerated between (datetime(2024-10-01) .. datetime(2024-10-31))
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Identity, ResultType, CorrelationId
```

 carla.security: Great — add retention proof: CloudTrail has S3/CloudTrail Lake buckets with object list + bucket policy screenshots; GCP export to BigQuery dataset info + retention policy; Azure Diagnostic Storage container + retention. We should link to the exact artifacts.

 david-cloud: Also include key metadata snapshots: `aws kms describe-key --key-id <arn>` and `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <arn>` outputs. Rotation evidence: `ScheduleKeyRotation` and key-rotation-status showing true, or KMS key aliases with version stamp.

 alice.m: GCP rotation: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key key-name --location LOCATION --keyring KEYRING` shows versions and state. For CMKs managed through CMEK, include the resource that references the key (e.g., BigQuery dataset encryption config).

 neal.sre: Azure: `az keyvault key show --vault-name <vault> --name <key>` plus `az keyvault key list-deleted` if needed. Also export Diagnostic Settings config: `az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/.../providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>`

 carla.security: For RBAC changes we need: IAM policy diffs (Cloud Audit logs `serviceData.policyDelta` or CloudTrail `PutKeyPolicy` events), Azure RoleAssignment operations, and AWS CloudTrail `PutKeyPolicy` / `CreateGrant` / `RetireGrant`. Those are the canonical events.

 david-cloud: Agreed. For CreateGrant/RetireGrant also show the grantId and granteePrincipal that were used. If the app uses grants for KMS on EC2/ECS, include the mapping.

 carla.security: Action items: 1) david-cloud — produce an S3 tar with CloudTrail CSV/JSON extracts for the month + `describe-key` outputs (due EOD Fri). 2) alice.m — export BigQuery queries and policyDelta samples + GCP key snapshots. 3) neal.sre — export Azure Diagnostic Queries, and Diagnostic Settings JSON. 4) I'll assemble the SOC2 evidence pack and mapping doc.

 kms-arch-bot: Artifact uploaded: `s3://redwood-audit-buckets/kms-evidence/oct-2024/cloudtrail-extract.tar.gz` :white_check_mark:

 alice.m: Uploaded GCP exports to `gs://redwood-audit-exports/kms/oct-2024/` — added README with query examples.

 david-cloud: Putting AWS CLI commands and Athena queries into the ticket. Will ping when done.

 carla.security: Thanks all. If anyone spots missing event types or edge cases (e.g., multi-region trails, cross-account decrypts), flag here.

 neal.sre: One more edge case: HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM/Bring-your-own keys) may have separate audit evidence — note in the pack if any keys are HSM-backed.

 carla.security: Noted. End of thread. :lock:
